data.one_liner: Simple count-up and countdown timer package for stopwatch applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stopwatch timer with support for count up and count down modes, lap times, preset durations, and formatted time displays via streams or callbacks.
use_when: You need to build a stopwatch or countdown timer in your Flutter app.
You want easy streaming of raw time, minute time, second time, and lap records.
avoid_when: You need a background alarm or scheduling plugin that persists when the app is terminated.
strengths: Supports both count-up and count-down modes.
Provides streams and callbacks for raw time, lap records, and intervals.
Built-in formatting helper for time strings.
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of the timer instance to avoid memory leaks.
